facts.text: Obtain protection against the black dragon's poison before going after the dragon.

Sir Phidipaldi's plan names the witch or the alchemist as possible sources of protection against the black dragon's poison; the party must visit one of them after returning from the Barrow Mound. Any cost is not yet known.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play has not established that either the witch or the alchemist can or will provide such protection, or at what price.
